title: Adjustment Credit Redemption and Lapse — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Adjustment credit terms — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** An adjustment credit is spent only on replacement tires.

- **Validity.** The credit must be applied no later than the end of the credit validity period counted from the treadwear adjustment that issued the credit. Calendar days are counted from the day after the anchor date, so the anchor date plus the number of days is the last qualifying date. The validity period is the line's credit validity in days.
- **Which tires.** When the line requires the same line, the replacement tire must be of the same line as the adjusted set; otherwise any Crestline tire line may be bought.
- **Mounting.** When the line includes mounting with the credit, the replacement tire's mounting and balancing is not charged on the replacement ticket.
- **Several credits.** Several credits of one set may go on one replacement ticket, each as its own credit-applied entry citing its own adjustment.
- **Never.** A credit is never paid out in cash, moved to another set or another customer, or combined with a satisfaction-trial refund of the same set.
- **Lapse.** The day after the validity period ends, whatever remains of the credit lapses and is booked as an expiry for exactly the credit remaining on that adjustment; a credit fully applied lapses nothing. Closing the set does not cancel a credit that is still within its validity period.
- **Amount applied — clause no longer in force as first issued.** The clause "the amount applied may not exceed the credit remaining for that adjustment, and it reduces only the tire price on the replacement ticket, never installation charges, fees or tax" is no longer in force as a rule for every credit applied. It holds for every credit applied other than one toward a workmanship share charged on the same set, which settles only the tire part of that share and never more than the credit remaining, and other than one toward a one-tire replacement ticket written against a treadwear adjustment credit, where the credit applied is the smaller of the credit remaining and the ticket's tire line and reduces only that tire line, never installation charges, fees or tax.

**Validity, both sides (hypothetical 60-day credit issued on day 0):** applied on day 60 — within validity; applied on day 61 — the remainder has lapsed.

superseded_clauses: The amount applied may not exceed tires_msr_credit_remaining for that adjustment, and it reduces only the tire price on the replacement ticket, never installation charges, fees or tax.
